title: campanula rotundifolia var. angustifolia
intro: Campanula rotundifolia var. angustifolia, commonly known as Scottish Bluebell, is a plant species in the Campanulaceae family, which is native to the mountainous regions of Europe and Asia. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation and improve respiratory issues due to its expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Campanula rotundifolia var. angustifolia include its use as an anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antispasmodic agent, which can help alleviate pain and soothe irritated tissues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, glycosides, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
